spans.s:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Expecting.
E.
अप before ईक्ष to see, ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be regarded or considered.
2 Desirable.
E.
अप before ईक्ष to see, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Expectation, hope.
2 Regard, reference, consideration.
3 Connexion of cause and effect.
4 Absolute connexion, as of an individual with its species.
5 Necessity, need, occasion.
E.
अप, ईक्ष to see, अङ and टाप् affs.

f. (-द्धिः)
Clearness of understanding, the faculty of arranging and methodising a variety of considerations.
E.
अपेक्षा, and बुद्धि intellect.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Regarded, considered, referred to.
2 Wished, hoped.
3 Connected.
E.
अप, ईक्ष to see, क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be regarded or considered.
2 Desirable, estimable.
E.
अप and ईक्ष to see, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-क्षी-क्षिणी-क्षि)
1 Expecting, hoping, an expectant.
2 Looking to.
E.
अपेक्षा and इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 To be regarded or considered.
2 To be wished or desired.
ind.
Having considered, having, or with, regard or reference to.
E.
अप, ईक्ष to see, यत् or य aff.

Open, apart.
E.
अप, and इत gone.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Inexpert.
E.
अ neg. पेशल clever.
